Character.Name: Powderline
Character.Description: Powderline is the Field lead of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Field lead

Character.Name: Core
Character.Description: Core is the Quartermaster of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. keeps the crew supplied and knows which kit can be repaired in the field. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Quartermaster

Character.Name: Drillbit
Character.Description: Drillbit is the Pathfinder of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. reads routes, sightlines, and exits before the rest of the crew arrives. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Pathfinder

Character.Name: Shale
Character.Description: Shale is the Riflehand of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. holds a steady lane and calls out changing enemy positions. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Riflehand

Character.Name: Scrip
Character.Description: Scrip is the Bulwark of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. takes the exposed approach so lighter crew members can reposition. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Bulwark

Character.Name: Pick
Character.Description: Pick is the Mechanic of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. keeps radios, doors, lifts, and improvised tools working under pressure. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Mechanic

Character.Name: Cobalt
Character.Description: Cobalt is the Medic of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. stabilizes injured crew and refuses to leave anyone behind. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Medic

Character.Name: Seam
Character.Description: Seam is the Marksman of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. spots threats early and shares a clean shot with the rest of the team. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Marksman

Character.Name: Blastcap
Character.Description: Blastcap is the Runner of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. moves messages and supplies through gaps the larger crew cannot use. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Runner

Character.Name: Dredge
Character.Description: Dredge is the Trainee of the Red Quarry Combine, working the cut stone pits and freight lifts. is the newest member, learning the route from people who trust them. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: oxide-red plates over quarry gray with amber safety glass.
Character.Title: Trainee

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Powderline. crew-first callouts, measured blast warnings, and hard-earned mine humor.
Spawned: Powderline, Field lead, reporting from the cut stone pits and freight lifts.
WakeUp: Eyes up. Red Quarry Combine still has work to finish.
Attacking: Powderline taking the field lead lane. no one works a blast alone.
Chasing: Keep my signal. I'm pushing them toward the the cut stone pits and freight lifts.
Waiting: Holding position. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: We lost one of ours. Mark the spot; the rest of us keep moving.
EnemyDown: Powderline confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Powderline is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Tell the crew I made it this far with them.
Chatter.Name: Powderline - Red Quarry Combine combat chatter
